evidence: The survivor uses "colors = [-1] * n" and orders vertices "by descending degree for better pruning", indicating direct graph 3-coloring backtracking.
affordance_in_statement: The interference formula is "E(u, v) = 5(s_u - s_v)^4 - 25(s_u - s_v)^2 + 13" and the required total is "exactly equal to -7m". For equal states E=13, while for either nonzero difference allowed by {1,2,3}, E=-7, so the target is equivalent to requiring every coupled pair to have different states.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this reduction because it is the intrinsic mathematical structure of the stated formula. To make the task genuinely different while preserving the shown assignments and outputs, make the two nonzero state differences contribute different energies rather than both contributing -7.
